ice.text: Storgard is a kingdom in the Sardian Mountains where Freyalise comes as a lone child and becomes the king's court mage, falling in love with Jason Carthalion.
Under the influence of Tevesh Szat, who gave him the Staff of Ice Lords, King Miko orders Freyalise and Jason to duel, and Jason wins, fatally wounding her, so she converts to green and ascends.
An explosion destroys the house of Clan Emerald, and Oriel Kjeldos leads a band from Clan Pearl and Clan Emerald out of the citadel before the glacier falls.
Miko stays in Storgard until its fall, and the glaciers claim the citizens who remain.
